# Deposit Amount Column Alignment Override
The `AccountDetailTable.vue` in zhi2-web-admin hardcoded `align: 'left'` for the deposit amount column, overriding the default right alignment.

## Problem
- `guaranteeDepositAccount/components/AccountDetailTable.vue` set `align: 'left'` on the "缴存金额(元)" column
- This overrode `zs-table-column` default right alignment for amount columns

## Solution
- Changed `align` to `'right'` to match list page and detail basic info area

# Login Name Column Field Mapping Error
The logininfor list column bound `prop` to `loginName` while the API returns `userName`, causing blank column.

## Problem
- `system/logininfor/index.vue` columns defined `prop: 'loginName'` for "登录名称" column
- Interface returned field was `userName`, resulting in empty display

## Solution
- Changed `prop` to `userName` to correctly map and display

# Valid Bill Selection Restricted by Payment Status
The `spFeeBill` module's `isSelectable` relied on `isBillPayable`, blocking selection of valid paid bills.

## Problem
- `spFeeBill` `isSelectable` depended on `isBillPayable` allowing only unpaid/partial paid non-voided bills
- Valid already-paid bills could not be selected

## Solution
- Added `isBillValid()` and `validateBillsForDiscount()` in `enums.js`
- Changed `isSelectable` to `isBillValid(row)` so all valid bills selectable
- Receipt and discount go through different validations

# Home Index Vue Calls toggleSideBar
The `home/index.vue` `created` hook called `toggleSideBar`, collapsing the default expanded sidebar.

## Problem
- `home/index.vue` `created` invoked `toggleSideBar`
- Vuex default `opened: true` sidebar got switched to collapsed

## Solution
- Removed the call in `home/index.vue`
- Added auto-expand logic in `Navbar.vue` `goHome` when sidebar collapsed
